from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single judgment document with its identifying metadata."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title or identifier of the judgment document")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific case cause (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
